<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #22199 <!-- REMOVE this line if no issue to close -->

Problem Summary:
Runtime error index-out-of-range occurs when running `select t1.*, (select t2.* from t1) from t1`.

### What is changed and how it works?

What's Changed & How it Works:
When `correlatedAggregateResolver` leaves `ast.Node`, check the `err` field to determine whether to stop visiting. In this way, caller can be aware of the error.

### Related changes

- PR to update `pingcap/docs`/`pingcap/docs-cn`:
- Need to cherry-pick to the release branch

### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- Unit test
- Integration test
